title: GenerationRequest
description: What the gateway sends to start a generation. Two pointers and nothing else: the service version to generate against, and the order whose answers are the input.

service_version_id.description: The published service version to generate against. A version rather than a service, because an issued document pins the version it was produced from.

order_id.description: The order this generation is for. The client's answers are read against it.
